LDMARKD.Settings.ModuleEnabled.Name: Condition Watch Enabled
LDMARKD.Settings.ModuleEnabled.Hint: Whether players can currently see condition details on tokens (NPCs, monsters, and party members). Toggled live via the Condition Watch button in the Token scene controls.
LDMARKD.Settings.ShowControlButton.Name: Show Scene Control Button
LDMARKD.Settings.ShowControlButton.Hint: Show the Condition Watch toolbar controls (GM only). Turning this off hides them, but does not by itself disable the player-facing feature.
LDMARKD.Controls.Toggle.Title: Toggle Condition Watch
LDMARKD.Controls.OpenHub.Title: Open GM Hub
LDMARKD.Notify.Enabled: Condition Watch: players can now see token conditions.
LDMARKD.Notify.Disabled: Condition Watch: hidden from players again.
LDMARKD.Hub.Title: LD Markd — GM Hub
